SELECT I.INC_ID AS incId, I.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, I.TITLE AS title, I.SEVERITY AS severity, I.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, I.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, TO_CHAR(I.OCCR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS occrDt, TO_CHAR(I.RCPT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS rcptDt FROM OPS_INCIDENT I LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON I.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'INCIDENT_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = I.STATUS WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY I.INC_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_INCIDENT I WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT I.INC_ID AS incId, I.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, I.TITLE AS title, I.CONTENT AS content, I.SEVERITY AS severity, I.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, TO_CHAR(I.OCCR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS occrDt, TO_CHAR(I.RCPT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS rcptDt, TO_CHAR(I.RESOLVE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS resolveDt, TO_CHAR(I.TARGET_RESOLVE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS targetResolveDt, I.REF_PRB_ID AS refPrbId, I.CAUSE AS cause, I.ACTION AS action, I.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, I.REG_ID AS regId, TO_CHAR(I.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_INCIDENT I LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON I.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'INCIDENT_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = I.STATUS WHERE I.INC_ID = #{incId}

SELECT H.HIS_ID AS hisId, H.INC_ID AS incId, H.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, H.CONTENT AS content, H.PROC_ID AS procId, TO_CHAR(H.PROC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS procDt FROM OPS_INCIDENT_HIS H LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'INCIDENT_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = H.STATUS WHERE H.INC_ID = #{incId} ORDER BY H.HIS_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_INCIDENT (SYS_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, SEVERITY, STATUS, OCCR_DT, RCPT_DT, TARGET_RESOLVE_DT, CHARGER_ID, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{severity}, #{status}, TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(#{occrDt}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(#{targetResolveDt}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')NULL, #{chargerId}, #{regId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE OPS_INCIDENT SET SYS_ID = #{sysId}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, SEVERITY = #{severity}, CHARGER_ID = #{chargerId} WHERE INC_ID = #{incId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_INCIDENT_HIS (INC_ID, STATUS, CONTENT, PROC_ID, PROC_DT) VALUES (#{incId}, #{status}, #{content}, #{procId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT E.ESCAL_ID AS escalId, E.INC_ID AS incId, E.ESCAL_LEVEL AS escalLevel, EC.CODE_NM AS escalLevelNm, E.ESCAL_TO AS escalTo, E.REASON AS reason, E.ESCAL_BY AS escalBy, TO_CHAR(E.ESCAL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS escalDt FROM OPS_INCIDENT_ESCAL E LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE EC ON EC.CODE_GRP = 'ESCAL_LEVEL' AND EC.CODE_ID = E.ESCAL_LEVEL WHERE E.INC_ID = #{incId} ORDER BY E.ESCAL_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_INCIDENT_ESCAL (INC_ID, ESCAL_LEVEL, ESCAL_TO, REASON, ESCAL_BY, ESCAL_DT) VALUES (#{incId}, #{escalLevel}, #{escalTo}, #{reason}, #{escalBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
